generations.name: First generation (OS)
generations.notes: Launch: 64 kWh pack in North America (39.2 kWh pack sold elsewhere). The 2022 facelift changed styling only. first_year 2019 is from general knowledge of the North American launch (late 2018 as a 2019 model) and was not confirmed on a cited page; Wikipedia's 2018 date is for the gas Kona. The 2023 Kona Electric was sold in both the US (final first-gen year, 258 mi EPA, limited states) and Canada. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyundai_Kona_Electric ; https://hyundaicanada.com/showroom/2023/kona-electric ; https://insideevs.com/news/686388/2024-hyundai-kona-electric-debuts/

generations.name: Second generation (SX2)
generations.notes: All-new body. Standard Range ~48.6 kWh and Long Range ~64.8 kWh packs (Wikipedia also gives 48.4/65.4); DC ~74 kW (SR) and ~102 kW (LR) per an ADAC figure. Canada has a 2026 model (single Preferred trim, Long Range pack); the US skipped 2026. Pack sizes differ between Hyundai Canada (64.8 kWh) and press (65.4 kWh). DC peaks are European (ADAC) figures, not North American. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyundai_Kona_Electric ; https://cars.com/articles/hyundai-pauses-kona-electric-for-2026-kia-discontinues-niro-phev-521230/ ; https://www.hyundaicanada.com/en/showroom/2026/kona-electric
